title: An introduction to string states and their interactions
summary: The subject matter of these lecture notes is the open bosonic critical string, its perturbative spectrum and interactions. We begin with a brief review of classical string propagation, quantization, as well as the level-by-level construction of physical string states. We then review a new, covariant and efficient technology of constructing entire trajectories of infinitely many physical states deeper in the string spectrum.
